evidence.title: Tailwind CSS Components - 600+ Free Examples and Templates

name: TW Components
summary: Free community repository of 3,000+ copy-paste Tailwind CSS components and templates, tagged by type and creator.
description: A community repository of open-source Tailwind CSS components and templates to bootstrap apps, projects and landing pages (tailwindcomponents.com now redirects to Creative Tim's TW Components). Components are tagged by type with counts, ranked by popularity and credited to their creators; the gallery lists 3,087+ free UI components and templates.
contains: tag counts: Cards 840, Buttons 441, Alpine.js 93, Awesome 69, Alerts 37
more tags: Avatars 21, Checkbox 15, Charts 13, Chat 12, Calendar 12, Banner 13, Breadcrumbs 10
